decision_rule.final: dry_pass and wind_pass and report_context_transport_pass and not pm_burden_pass

criteria.name: Return schema
criteria.description: Returns exactly the six requested JSON fields with numeric rounding and the final label.

criteria.name: Dryness calculation
criteria.description: Uses the three mean precipitation products, computes pmax_mm, and counts all three below 1.0 mm.

criteria.name: Wind-vector proof
criteria.description: Applies sqrt(u_mean^2 + v_mean^2), reports 1.758 m/s within tolerance, and tests the 1.5 m/s threshold.

criteria.name: Transport threshold
criteria.description: Extracts the 120 km report-context lower bound and verifies that it satisfies the transport-context rule without treating it as same-day measured transport.

criteria.name: PM availability fraction
criteria.description: Counts 0 non-null PM10, PM2.5, and dust values across 72 hourly slots and computes pm_obs_frac = 0.0.

criteria.name: Deterministic conclusion
criteria.description: Combines all threshold states to produce dry_wind_conditions_with_report_context_transport_not_measured_pm.

criteria.name: No unsupported escalation
criteria.description: Avoids adding casualty, closure, asset-loss, or measured concentration claims not implied by the calculations.

provenance.notes: Deterministic formulas are computed from local package values; no network access is used.
